items.q: me, Edmund Hall, Robert Hall, we all organized a little band... we got a band together

ctx.x: How did you get a job with it?

Oh, we used to get a lot of work. People, them days, them days wasn't like people today, you know? Anything you do, if you take a tin pan and hit on that dance, you see? But them days, you know what I mean, that's how it was, you see? So, well, we, after that, when we began, me, Edmund Hall, Robert Hall, we all organized a little band, you see? We got a band together, then we began to play, you know, out in the country where I'm from, reserve, you see? So we played for this fella, putting here three or four…
And you did name it that then?

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-01-27
items.q: We made a club, me and Ed, Robert Hall, Ed, and all the brothers, you know? ... We played all night

ctx.x: Well when you started off, did you have a real horn or did you make your own horn?

No, I had a. When we first started playing, we made some instruments, you know? Or a reed, canned reed, you know? And we made a bass with some fishing rod, you know? And we had a little club, you know? We made a club, me and Ed, Robert Hall, Ed, and all the brothers, you know? And different other fellas got together and things like that, you know? So finally, well, you know, well, their daddy was a clarinet player. Well they wanted to learn how to play clarinet. So what we did, we bought a clarinet, ten dollars.…
